findings.evidence: Evaluation.lean: `namespace TauCeti` (l.51), `namespace GroupLike` (l.55), `theorem evaluationBialgEquivOfLinearIndependentOfSpanEqTop_apply` (l.272) and `evaluationBialgEquiv_apply` (l.338) are unprefixed; the new lemmas use `_root_.GroupLike.`.
findings.fix: Drop the `_root_.` prefix so both lemmas are `TauCeti.GroupLike.evaluation..._symm_val`, next to the declarations they describe.
findings.issue: `_root_.GroupLike.evaluationBialgEquivOfLinearIndependentOfSpanEqTop_symm_val` and `_root_.GroupLike.evaluationBialgEquiv_symm_val` (line 360) characterise `TauCeti.GroupLike.evaluationBialgEquiv*` but sit in root `GroupLike`, while the sibling `_apply`/`_toBialgHom` lemmas sit in `TauCeti.GroupLike`, so forward and inverse lemmas are in different namespaces.

findings.evidence: Post-PR file: l.78 `@[simp] theorem subtype_rTensor_comp_inducedCoact` (∘ₗ form only); l.93 `@[simp] induced_coact`; l.99 `theorem subtype_rTensor_coact` has no simp attribute and now needs `LinearMap.congr_fun` to get the pointwise statement.
findings.fix: Restore the applied lemma as `@[simp]` and derive `subtype_rTensor_comp_inducedCoact` from it with `ext n; exact ...`, as before.
findings.issue: Removing `@[simp] subtype_rTensor_inducedCoact` leaves no simp lemma for `(SMulMemClass.subtype N).rTensor C (N.inducedCoact n)`. The remaining `@[simp]` lemma is about the composite `∘ₗ` and does not fire on applied terms, and `subtype_rTensor_coact` is not simp (its LHS is rewritten by `induced_coact`). The applied lemma is not a duplicate; it is the pointwise normal form.

summary: The new GroupLike inverse lemmas are put in a different namespace from the equivalences they describe and from their `_apply` siblings, and removing `subtype_rTensor_inducedCoact` leaves `inducedCoact` with no `@[simp]` lemma for the map applied to an element.
